title: AI Office

paragraphs.text: The Commission shall develop Union expertise and capabilities in the field of AI through the AI Office.
Member States shall facilitate the tasks entrusted to the AI Office, as reflected in this Regulation.

text: Article 64 AI Office 1. The Commission shall develop Union expertise and capabilities in the field of AI through the AI Office. 2. Member States shall facilitate the tasks entrusted to the AI Office, as reflected in this Regulation.
